groups.summary: The CA private key, certificate, and configuration file were updated to include the CA constraint (basicConstraints = critical, CA:true). groups.summary: The debug middleware now constructs a Response object for error tracebacks instead of manually writing headers and body, improving clarity and consistency. Static resources are served with proper MIME types, ETag headers, and support for conditional requests, enhancing caching and efficiency.
groups.title: Refactor DebuggedApplication to use Response for error pages and improve static resource handling

groups.summary: The Ubuntu font and its license file were removed, and the CSS was updated to use standard system fonts instead of the embedded Ubuntu font, simplifying the debugger's styling and removing font dependencies.

groups.summary: The default status code for append_slash_redirect is changed from 301 to 308 to preserve the request method and body during redirects. The function's docstring and related tests are updated accordingly.

groups.title: Fix test client redirect handling and enforce warnings as errors in pytest

groups.summary: The main change removes pytest-xprocess and replaces it with ephemeral_port_reserve and a new DevServerClient class to manage live dev server processes and requests. This includes a large refactor of tests/conftest.py and updates to test_serving.py to use the new approach.

groups.summary: Several test files have had pytest warning filters for PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning removed, likely because the new approach no longer triggers these warnings.
